problems: The chocolate chips read as eyes: each cookie shows two dark dots side by side above the rim, so the three cookies look like little faces peeking out, not cookies. Scatter more, smaller, uneven chips at different heights.

The lid seems to hover. The comment calls it hinged, but a ceramic jar has no hinge and none is modelled. Make the back edge of the lid sit on the back of the lip and add a ring under the lid that drops just inside the neck, so it clearly rests on the jar.
At -12 degrees the lid touches only the middle cookie, and the side cookies stop short of it. Tilt the lid a little more and raise the side cookies so all three hold the lid up.
